description: Golden fixtures for evals/linter-eval.cjs. Each fixture pairs a hand-authored file with a KNOWN correct verdict, so the anti-slop linters can be graded mechanically (no LLM judge). Three shapes, same discipline as the outcome eval: positive (planted slop — expected rule must fire: recall), negative (clean content — nothing may fire: precision), adversarial (looks like a violation but is legitimate — nothing may fire). Fixtures live outside public/ so they never pollute --all sweeps or the pre-commit pipeline.

text.note: corpus also lists 'delve' under HEDGE-VOCAB — both fire
corpus also lists 'stands as a beacon' under FILLER — both fire

'vibrant community' is also a FILLER pattern. CHALLENGE-FORMULA was INERT on first eval run (', ' cannot match when a space follows the comma) — corpus fixed 2026-07-29, this fixture is its regression test
Closed em-dashes (corpus bans spaced ones), 'the important part' (not didactic formula), 'did not respond' (no not-x-but-y), 'hardest challenge' (no despite+faces)

layout.note: ONE tell hex (L2 needs 2), ONE default shadow (L3 needs 3), ONE opacity-only transition (L4 needs 2), SEVEN identical cards (L5 needs 8), prose emoji (L1 is chrome-only), one centered headline (L6 needs 12+)

code.note: route-doc comment (// GET /api/...), documented-silence catch (comment explains WHY), stderr-reporting catch — all deliberate
comment mentions typing at a validated JSON boundary without using as-any — prose about types is not a cast
